answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that vests slowly: a newcomer deposits capital before it can trade, and the stake is slashed if peers prove it duplicated work. At dawn of each epoch the ledger publishes each agent's stake and history, so a sybil tide of fresh identities still costs real money per copy, while honest agents earn the stake back. Crystal-clear on-chain accounting makes the attack price visible before it starts.
